items.a: Domestic shipping in Korea is ₩3,000 and free on orders of ₩100,000 or more. Remote areas may have an extra fee.

items.q: How do I choose my size?
items.a: Each product page shows the model's height, weight and size worn (e.g. 170cm / 82kg, wears XL). Please also check the fit, such as oversized or muscle fit.
You earn 1% of your purchase amount as points. For example, a ₩69,000 item earns 690 points.

items.q: How do I exchange or return an item?
items.a: Contact us through our KakaoTalk channel or customer service (+82 10-5817-8169) with your order number.
International shipping will open step by step. We'll announce it in our notices.
